title: Mlai entry systemdesign model versioning
question: What would you put in place around model versioning and deployment to make this kind of incident faster to catch and recover from?
idealAnswer:
Every deployed model version should be tagged and versioned along with the exact code, data snapshot, and hyperparameters used to produce it, so any live version can be reproduced or audited

Keep the previous model version ready to serve, so rollback is a fast configuration change, not a re-training or re-deployment

Automated evaluation gates before promotion, the new model shouldn't go live unless it clears key metrics against a held-out set or recent live traffic

Monitoring on live prediction distributions, e.g. false positive rate, prediction volume, with alerting, so a regression like this is caught in minutes or hours, not a day

A staged rollout, canary or shadow deployment to a small percentage of traffic first, limits the blast radius of a bad model before it affects all users
